notes.title: BBB Visual Novel Release delayed ... again. Yup. Again.
notes.notes:
Hello all!

Just updating everyone as X-MiGuPLAY will be delaying this release. Again. 

The script has been done more or less since (scratches chin, sips some coffee) April 2019ish? One of the draw backs of producing games alone is... when delays happen, it can be like a horse kick in the nuts. But I'm not angry. I love making these games and the delays have been driven by positive things like adding content & getting Anya's voice actress to do an F ton of voices to bring this novel to life. 

So what has happened and where are we at?

1. NSFW Adults ONLY is official. The boobs are on the loose. The final decision has been made to keep this visual novel in its original form and not hold back the content that pushes the game into Adults Only land.

2. With the NSFW state locked in, I added bonus content that is appropriately inappropriate. This game will ship with bonus lapdance content similar to Anya's X-Mas Special. Plus we are including some palette modded BBB Power Claw brawling action too.

3. Voice acting. The decision to add voice acting has contributed greatly to the delays. The novel is approx 22,000 words long and we sat down and recorded every word. Voice recordings wrapped last week. Mixes were done this week and currently the sounds bites are being chopped up and exported for game engine import. 

4. Music. I wrote and arranged new music. That too is time consuming.

I think those are all the talking points I got. Hope to release before August and hope people enjoy it when it is done! Hope everyone out there is staying healthy and safe during these crazy times. Cheers.

-M

notes.title: X-MiGuPLAY NEWS & Site update!
notes.notes:
Hello Steam land!

NEWS!

1. X-MiGuPLAY  has updated xmiguplay.com for 2020. Upcoming games have been added to the site and we tried to pull the site out of the 90s and give it a more modern feel! As always opinions are welcomed!

2. X-MiGuPLAY's Business standing: How to deliver this without it coming across the wrong way?

Let me try. So ... we are profitable! Now, we haven't  sold a million copies or anything crazy but, I wanted to announce this. I was doing some marketing research and learned that most indie devs fail in regard to recovering initial investments. 

I am happy to say we have covered our initial investment and while we maintain a small  revolving debt for investments, as any company would, we were stoked to see that we hit this milestone.   

From the outside looking in, it may seem that our traffic is pretty dismal but, as we discovered in our traffic breakdowns, we learned that we've actually ranked on Best Sellers on several occasions. So, long story short, THANK YOU to all that have supported this venture ... 

This truly is a labor of love and we are committed to bringing more content and improving along the way!

3. Bare Boob Brawlerz's's'ss Visual Novel will come out ... but when it is ready! The delays on this title have been driven by adding more & more illustrative work, which is pretty time consuming. Almost all frames involve scene pre-renders with 3D models and then digitally drawn Manga inspired adaptations. In addition to that, we are scheduling time for voicing the entire thing. Novel is currently pushing 22,000 words and we've surpassed 200 illustrations thus far.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/906560/Bare_Boob_Brawlerz_Novel_01_Visual_Novel/

4. Dr. DONG is coming : its in pre-production now, core plot scripting, character designs and environmental plotting is pretty much what we are working on now. I hope the game comes out this year but, that could be pretty unrealistic sooooo ... we shall see. 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1217950/Dr_Dick_Dong_Stripper_Underworld/


That's all I got to blab about. So, thank you and have a dope a$$ weekend!

Regards, 
-M

notes.title: New Version of STRIPPER ANYA 2.0 aka VST ...coming soon
notes.notes:
Hello all! For those who don't know, Stripper Anya: Demon Slayer has a pretty big update coming down the pipe.  Here is some info!

Stripper Anya Demon Slayer is getting upgraded to Version 2.0 and will now go by "Stripper Anya: Demon Slayer VST"

What you need to know: Everyone that owns Stripper Anya: Demon Slayer on Steam will get auto upgraded to Version 2.0 (VST) in early 2019.

While the upgrade adds NEW graphics for Anya, NEW moves, NEW weapons, Manga/Anime style stills for the cut scenes, NEW enemies and revised levels and code ... X-MiGuPLAY is leaving the original 2017 version of 'Stripper Anya: Demon Slayer" intact and available in the game. 

I wanted to upgrade the game while I was in the process of prototyping future X-MiGuPLAY Brawlers/HackNSlash titles & developing Bare Boob Brawlers, it was important to me to not remove the original version of Stripper Anya: Demon Slayer. 

At the same time, I did not want to be a F***face and make VST a separate purchase for existing owners. So, both version ship digitally together as one. The original version of Stripper Anya: Demon Slayer will now be referred to as "The Legacy Version" going forward. 

 
More details to come...

-M

notes.title: Stripper Anya is getting an update!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

As I am deep in developing Bare Boob Brawlers: Power Claw (BBBPC), some of my approaches to the development process has been affected so much so that ... today I am announcing that Stripper Anya Demon Slayer will be getting an update!

Though the update will likely not happen until 2019, I have decided to work on this while I am revising memory management on X-MiGu Fighters and building 3D assets and writing the foundational code for BBBPC.

The extent of the update is not yet fully determined. However, at the top of the list is optimizing the crap out of Stripper Anya: Demon Slayer!

Thanks!


-M
